description: This Java source file defines the class FineractRequestContextHolder, which manages environment-specific request attributes within the Fineract project. It provides methods to get and set request attributes, considering different contexts such as HTTP requests, batch requests, and thread-bound request attributes.

classes.name: FineractRequestContextHolder
classes.description: A final class that manages request attributes in different execution contexts, such as HTTP requests, batch requests, and thread-bound contexts within the Fineract infrastructure.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves the attribute value associated with the given key, checking request, batch, and thread contexts.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves the attribute value for the given key, optionally using a provided HttpServletRequest to prioritize request scope.

methods.name: setAttribute
methods.description: Sets an attribute value for the given key in the current context, defaulting to null request.

methods.name: setAttribute
methods.description: Sets an attribute value for the given key, request, or thread context depending on the provided parameters.

methods.name: isBatchRequest
methods.description: Static method that returns true if the current thread is handling a batch request.
